title: m3a library QA reasons (library/baselines/qa.json)
description: Why the library keeps the clips the sensors flag (PLAN.md WP-5.8, D66): the warn level's reason, a reason per set for its fails, a reason per clip and metric, a reason per clip that stands off the floor, where each loop with no contact is instead of on its feet, why a loop on its feet with no contact has no foot that holds still, and why a clip whose motion never changes, untagged as a pose, stays so. tools/qa/verdict.ts reads it (reasonsProblems checks this shape) and the writers record the reasons in each clip's quality.baseline.

warn.description: why a clip at warn is kept

sets.description: per set, why its clips' fails are kept

clips.description: per clip id, per metric, why that finding is kept

floats.description: per clip id, why it stands off the floor where the float check (tools/qa/library.ts, D69) finds it

offFeet.description: per loop with no contact at all, where it is instead of on its feet (the off-feet check, tools/qa/library.ts, D104)

unplanted.description: per loop on its feet with no contact at all, why no foot holds still on the floor (the off-feet check, tools/qa/library.ts, D108)

still.description: per clip whose motion never changes though no tag says it is a pose (pose, reference), why it stays so (the still check, tools/qa/library.ts, F.13)
